paragraphs: Chalfai is Ilfa in Babylonia; see there. R. Huna and R. Acha, in R. Chalfai's name: Kohelet Midrash, on “What profit has man?” He asked R. Yosi and R. Shimon ben Lakish: Jerusalem Orlah, chapter 1, halakhah 4. In that matter in Nazir, chapter 6, halakhah 10, he asked R. Yochanan and R. Shimon ben Lakish. R. Yochanan said to him: Terumot, chapter 6. Rav Hila and R. Elazar, in his name: Maaserot, chapter 2. R. Yonah found it in Chalfai’s notebook, there. And R. Yosi bar Chanina: Jerusalem Bava Kamma, HaGozel Batra. R. Yudan bar Chalfai. R. Simon, in his name: Sheviit, chapter 6.
